D5_capability_profiles_and_observations.evidence: Stable capability profiles (ResearchCapabilityProfile) are strictly decoupled from dated observations (ResearchCapabilityObservation) and economic admission.

D6_graceful_degradation.evidence: Capability state machine independently models AVAILABLE, DEGRADED, UNAVAILABLE, QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, STALE, UNAUTHORIZED, and MISSING. Paid routes never activate implicitly.

acceptance_criteria_matrix.criterion: Stable capability declarations are separate from dated runtime/human observations and economic admission policy.
acceptance_criteria_matrix.test: Separation verified; changing observations or economic policies does not alter static profiles.

acceptance_criteria_matrix.criterion: Profiles can represent paper search, semantic search, deep review, structured extraction, API search, bulk export, citation graph, full text, manual-only, free quota, monthly quota, unlimited, API-key, paid-tier, and unavailable constraints.
acceptance_criteria_matrix.test: Provider-neutral capability vocabulary and constraints are strictly enforced

acceptance_criteria_matrix.criterion: CapabilityRegistry consumes availability observations and economic routing consumes quota/cost/admissibility facts without becoming corpus authority.
acceptance_criteria_matrix.test: CapabilityRegistry integration registers research capabilities and routes deterministically; Canonical Authority Isolation

acceptance_criteria_matrix.criterion: Missing, stale, unavailable, unauthorized, and quota-exhausted states reduce only the affected capability.
acceptance_criteria_matrix.test: Per-capability isolation: Degradation of one capability leaves other capabilities intact

acceptance_criteria_matrix.criterion: Explicit deterministic/local/manual/free fallbacks remain usable; paid lanes never activate implicitly.
acceptance_criteria_matrix.test: Hard Invariant: Paid fallback is PROHIBITED when free quota is exhausted; Manual/Free Fallback

acceptance_criteria_matrix.criterion: Baseline tests require no provider credentials or paid service.
acceptance_criteria_matrix.test: Baseline suite executes completely offline with zero credentials or network
